desktopFeatures: Computer use: type @ and pick Computer use. Lokizenith controls your PC with its own blue mouse and keyboard until the task is done or you press Stop
Screen share with a floating Stop button and a floating prompt bar that stay on top of every app
Voice calls that keep working while Lokizenith controls your PC, so you can add tasks or say stop
All permissions granted to the app, with a first-run check and clear fixes
System tray, Start with Windows (optional) and Run as administrator (optional)
Global hotkeys: Ctrl+Shift+L show/hide, Ctrl+Alt+Space floating bar, Ctrl+Alt+S stop
Open local files from disk, offline cache, native notifications and auto-update
notes: Independent Windows and Android apps that use the same Lokizenith accounts, chats, and admin user list as the website.
